about_the_game:
FOGBOUND is a psychological horror game set in a decaying city enshrouded in a toxic fog.

YOUR CITY IS HOLLOW.

A post-apocalyptic Lahore is slowly being erased by a toxic fog. As one of its last maintenance workers under the Air Quality Task Force, navigate its ruined streets and abandoned complexes. Salvage whatever parts of it you can.

THE AIR IS POISON.

Hollow shells of humans roam the city. They call them Sayas. Shadows. Stay clear. The military will handle them, or try to. Keep your gas mask on. Get the job done. Just know, the fog seeps into everything: blood or metal, lungs or memory.

YOUR HEART IS NUMB.

Amara. You brought her here. To your beautiful city. What a fantastic idea. It's on you to get her out now. Work hard enough, and maybe you'll get your exit forms approved. The air is growing thicker. Martial law isn't lifting anytime soon.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
